_readme: Topic queue for the automated blog (n8n on the Oracle server publishes Mon/Wed/Fri). The workflow takes the first topic whose slug is not yet in src/content/blog/. Each topic must target a different main keyword. Allowed values: cover = cleaning-robot | cleaning-robot-vertical | service-robot | reception-robot | handheld-device | operating-table | water-heater; related = project slugs from src/data/projects.ts; category = Guides | Process | Industries | Marketing.
